# Load packages

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ComplexUpset)
library(eulerr)
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
```

# Load data

```{r}
# Load the upcoming updated HPA data (version 25)
hpa_data <- read_csv("../data/HPA v.25/hpa_evidence_v25.csv")
```

# Plots

## Upset - Overlapping evidence status

```{r}
# Step 1: Use hpa_evidence_v25 as the base (since it now includes all annotation columns)
# Only keep rows with transcript-level evidence for UpSet of the RNA evidence sets
rna_datasets <- c("Tissue", "Brain", "Cell type", "Immune cell type", "Cell line")

evidence_only <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% rna_datasets)

# Step 2: Create wide format for UpSet
upset_data <- evidence_only %>%
  mutate(set_name = Evidence) %>%
  select(Ensembl, set_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = set_name, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

# Step 3: Set the order you want (reverse for plotting, first = top)
set_order <- c("Tissue evidence", "Brain evidence", "Cell type evidence", "Immune cell type evidence", "Cell line evidence")
# reverse set_order
set_order <- rev(set_order)
upset_data <- upset_data[, c("Ensembl", set_order)]

upset_data$overlap_count <- rowSums(upset_data[, set_order])

library(reshape2)
# (or tidyr::pivot_longer works too)

upset_long <- upset_data %>%
  select(Ensembl, overlap_count, all_of(set_order)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(set_order), names_to = "set", values_to = "present") %>%
  filter(present == 1) 


# Step 4: UpSet plot with set size numbers
fig2a <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  data = upset_data,
  intersect   = set_order,
  base_annotations = list(
    'Number of genes' = intersection_size(
      text = list(
        size     = 4,
        vjust    = -0.5,
        fontface = "bold",
        color    = "black"
      )
    )
  ),
  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(position = "left") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ..count..),
        stat     = "count",
        hjust    = 1,
        size     = 4,
        fontface = "bold",
        color    = "white"
      ) +
      labs(y = "Number of genes")
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  sort_sets   = FALSE,
  guides      = "over"
)

fig2a

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 2/Figure 2A.pdf", fig2a, width = 18, height = 7)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 2/Figure 2A.png", fig2a, width = 18, height = 7)
```

## B - barplot - Overlapping evidence status

```{r}
# Step 1: Filter out "No human protein/transcript evidence"
rna_datasets <- c("Tissue", "Brain", "Cell type", "Immune cell type", "Cell line")

rna_evidence <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% rna_datasets) |> 
  # Remove entries that starts with No in the Evidence column
  filter(!str_starts(Evidence, "No")) 

# Step 2: Count in how many datasets each gene appears
gene_counts <- rna_evidence %>%
  group_by(Ensembl) %>%
  summarise(N_evidence = n_distinct(Evidence), .groups = "drop")

# Step 3: Count genes per Dataset per overlap category
bar_data <- rna_evidence %>%
  left_join(gene_counts, by = "Ensembl") %>%
  count(Dataset, N_evidence)

# Label levels
bar_data <- bar_data %>%
  mutate(N_evidence = factor(N_evidence,
                             levels = 1:5,
                             labels = c("Unique to One", "Shared by 2", "Shared by 3", "Shared by 4", "Shared by All")))

# Step 4: Compute total genes per dataset for text labels
label_data <- bar_data %>%
  group_by(Dataset) %>%
  summarise(total_genes = sum(n))

# ... Steps 1-4 as you have them ...

set_order <- c("Cell line", "Immune cell type", "Cell type", "Brain", "Tissue")

bar_data <- bar_data %>%
  mutate(Dataset = factor(Dataset, levels = set_order)) %>%
  arrange(Dataset)

label_data <- label_data %>%
  mutate(Dataset = factor(Dataset, levels = set_order)) %>%
  arrange(Dataset)

# Step 5: Plot (no reorder, just use Dataset as factor)
fig2b <- ggplot(bar_data, aes(x = Dataset, y = n, fill = N_evidence)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  geom_text(data = label_data,
            aes(x = Dataset, y = total_genes, label = total_genes),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
 #           hjust = -0.1,   # adjust as needed
            vjust = -0.1,
            size = 5) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey70", "lightblue", "blue", "darkblue", "black")) +
  labs(x = "Dataset", y = "Number of Genes", fill = "Overlap Level",
       title = "Gene Overlap Across Datasets, >= 1 nTPM") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "top")

fig2b

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 2/Figure 2B.pdf", fig2b, width = 10, height = 7)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 2/Figure 2B.png", fig2b, width = 10, height = 7)
```

## C - Upset - Protein evidence status

```{r}
# Define your protein evidence datasets
protein_datasets <- c("Western blot", "Immunohistochemistry", "Immunofluorescence")

# Filter and select
upset_base <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% protein_datasets) %>%
  select(Ensembl, Evidence, Dataset, `Evidence annotation (protein)`)

# Make a binary wide matrix: 1 if evidence in dataset, 0 otherwise
upset_data <- upset_base %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, Evidence) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Evidence, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)

set_order <- c("Immunofluorescence evidence", "Immunohistochemistry evidence", "Western blot evidence",
               "No immunofluorescence evidence", "No immunohistochemistry evidence", "No western blot evidence")
# Reverse the order for plotting
set_order <- rev(set_order)
upset_data <- upset_data[, c("Ensembl", set_order)]

fig2c <- ComplexUpset::upset(
  upset_data,
  intersect = set_order,
  set_sizes = (
    upset_set_size(position = "right") +
      geom_text(
        aes(label = ..count..),
        stat = "count",
        hjust = 1,
        size = 4
      ) 
  ),
  width_ratio = 0.3,
  sort_sets = FALSE,
  guides = "over",
)

fig2c
```

## D - Protein evidence status (Venn diagram)

```{r}
# Define your protein evidence datasets
protein_datasets <- c("Western blot", "Immunohistochemistry", "Immunofluorescence")

# Filter and select
venn_base <- hpa_data %>%
  filter(Dataset %in% protein_datasets) %>%
  select(Ensembl, Evidence, Dataset, `Evidence annotation (protein)`) |>
  filter(`Evidence annotation (protein)` == "Evidence on protein-level")


# Make a binary wide matrix: 1 if evidence in dataset, 0 otherwise
venn_data <- venn_base %>%
  distinct(Ensembl, Evidence) %>%
  mutate(value = 1) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Evidence, values_from = value, values_fill = 0)


# Step 2: Make a logical matrix for Eulerr
supported_mat <- venn_data %>%
  select(Ensembl, `Immunofluorescence evidence`, `Immunohistochemistry evidence`, `Western blot evidence`) %>%
  distinct()

# Step 3: Set names for Eulerr
colnames(supported_mat) <- c("Ensembl", "IF", "IHC", "WB")

# Step 4: Create the Venn (logical matrix to eulerr)
venn_fit <- eulerr::euler(
  supported_mat %>% select(-Ensembl)
)

# Step 5: Plot
fig2c <- plot(
  venn_fit,
  fills = list(fill = c("darkgreen", "darkorange", "steelblue"), alpha = 0.6),
  labels = list(font = 2),
  quantities = TRUE,
  main = "Genes with Supported Status (IF, IHC, WB)"
)

fig2c

ggsave("../plots/pdf/Figure 2/Figure 2C.pdf", fig2c, width = 7, height = 5)
ggsave("../plots/png/Figure 2/Figure 2C.png", fig2c, width = 7, height = 5)
```


```{r}
venn_data |>
```

# Finalize plot

```{r}
library(ggpubr)
library(gridGraphics)

quartz()

# Plot and capture
plot(venn_fit,
     fills = list(fill = c("darkgreen", "darkorange", "steelblue"), alpha = 0.6),
     labels = list(font = 2),
     quantities = TRUE,
     main = "Genes with Supported Status (IF, IHC, WB)"
)
fig2d_grob <- grid::grid.grab() # Note: grid.grab(), not grid.grabExpr()

# Turn off the temporary device if you used one
# dev.off()

# Make ggplot-friendly
fig2d_gg <- cowplot::ggdraw() + cowplot::draw_grob(fig2d_grob)


figure_2 <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  fig2a, fig2b, fig2c, fig2d_gg,
  labels = "AUTO", label_size = 12, ncol = 2
)

cairo_pdf("results/figures/figure 2/Figure 2.pdf", width = 30, height = 18, pointsize = 5)
print(figure_2)
dev.off()
```
